text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold City finishes running the Hanshin JF. 
The crowd erupts with excitement, sending 
loud cheers her way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Pretty." "Beautiful." Hearing those 
words, Gold City felt frustrated by the 
same unchanging evaluations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seemed everyone around just wanted to 
see a pretty version of her wearing the 
Triple Tiara, not her true "running." If 
she merely lived up to expectations, she'd 
be nothing more than a mindless doll.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She said she wanted to choose her own 
path. The path ahead is the Classic Triple 
Crown. First, she set her sights on the 
Satsuki Sho!
